hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && ! echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(md|json|toml|ini|conf|log|txt|lock)$|/(docs|.claude|.git|node_modules|__pycache__|.pytest_cache|.vscode|.idea)/|\.(env|gitignore|dockerignore)$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"DOCUMENTATION GATE: Source file modified. Before signaling completion to the user, verify per .claude/rules/documentation.md: (1) Feature docs created/updated under docs/features/ if this is feature work (2) Architecture docs updated if structure changed (3) API docs updated if interfaces changed (4) Roadmap checkboxes updated if milestones completed (5) Requirements updated if functionality changed."}}'; fi; }
